name: Cumbres Mayores (Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross fimbriated in dark blue, the arms of the cross set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Cumbres Mayores (a castle on red and a crescent and tree on green).
history: Municipal flag of Cumbres Mayores; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross set towards the hoist, its arms edged in dark blue
